search_focus: official NREL/NLR H2FillS and FCEV data routes, DOE H2IQ real-fill reports, and open HRS data contracts

required: machine-readable synchronized station or dispenser pressure
vehicle or receiving-vessel pressure and temperature
mass flow or transferred mass on a common clock
engineering units, initial conditions and source checksum
controller, valve, cascade or ESD states
excluded_substitutes: software installers and example files without raw test provenance
published figures without machine-readable synchronized rows

screened_sources.title: NREL/NLR H2FillS
observed_scope: vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow outputs
empirical fueling data used in model development
screened_sources.claim_limit: The public route describes a validated software model and requires registration for the package; it does not expose a rights-cleared raw station-to-vehicle cohort suitable for an independent holdout.

screened_sources.title: NREL/NLR FCEV composite data products
observed_scope: fueling duration and fill amount aggregates
vehicle tank pressure and temperature summary products
screened_sources.claim_limit: Composite products are useful operating-envelope context, but they do not provide event-level common-clock station, dispenser and vehicle rows.

screened_sources.title: DOE H2IQ Hour: Hydrogen Fuel Dispensing for Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicles
observed_scope: real-fill pressure, temperature and mass-flow figures
station, hose, receptacle and vehicle-tank channels shown in charts
screened_sources.claim_limit: The report contains valuable real-fill figures but no machine-readable raw archive was located, so it cannot be scored as an independent holdout.

screened_sources.title: H2-Stations API v2
screened_sources.claim_limit: The public contract does not expose synchronized process telemetry or vehicle-side fill traces.

next_action: Send the prepared three-event schema request to the H2FillS/HITRF and real-station custodians, then freeze the exact files and scoring before numerical access.
claim_boundary: This is a public-access search and exclusion record. It adds no numerical validation and does not support an IJHE full-loop, field-safety or regulatory claim.
